notes.subject: נצחם
notes.rationale: literally 'their juice (of the grape)' — KJV 'their strength', ASV/JPS 'their lifeblood'; the wine-pressing metaphor of v.3 is kept here

notes.subject: wine imagery
notes.rationale: treading + making drunk + grape-juice sustain the winepress picture across the verse
